## Changed paths and behavior

- `services/documents/port/unit_of_work.go`: infrastructure-free typed transaction boundary.
- `services/documents/port/dependencies.go`: explicit feature transaction/readiness injection.
- `services/documents/migrations/0001_mechanics.up.sql`: private Documents v1 compatibility marker.
- `services/documents/adapter/postgres/unit_of_work.go`: inert constructor, fail-closed startup and transaction readiness.
- `services/documents/adapter/postgres/unit_of_work_test.go`: synthetic PostgreSQL, replay, concurrency, receipt recovery and fixture tests.
- This assigned result file.

Adapted the integrated Financing mechanics at
`0f4736a21db0d56fa17ca83934a43596a5352a35`; its five leaves are unchanged at this
task base. Read the T-009/T-017/T-018/T-010 contracts/results, architecture,
HTTP/cross-owner document rules, business/open decisions and both Gaze audits.
This preserves the Gaze-style port/adapter boundary; feature domain/app,
projections, subscribers and composition belong to their assigned later tasks.

The constructor performs no connection, query or migration. Explicit Check
and every Run transaction require the Documents database, current runtime role
AND runtime session_user, one clean v1 ledger row and the Documents owner marker.
Before binding feature repositories they reject owner/system/privileged reachable
roles, direct/PUBLIC/transitive NOINHERIT excess grants, metadata writes,
missing shared table/required column rights and a foreign owner default.
The transaction factory must bind every typed feature repository to the same
transaction; no SQL handle enters application ports. Repository errors must
propagate, and results remain candidates until commit succeeds. No automatic
retry, network action or broker publication occurs in the boundary.

The pure SQL owner migration requires separately installed shared mechanics,
the exact private migration role/database and one dirty v1 runner ledger row.
It creates only the owner compatibility marker and grants runtime read access;
it has no startup invocation or destructive rollback. The fixture exercises
this staged SQL installation protocol through psql; it does not test the
golang-migrate owner driver or a CLI against this new owner.

Pre-additive legacy installations are supported. Once additive messaging
objects exist, the protected owner/runtime/schema marker must remain ordinary,
non-RLS, non-writable by reachable runtime roles, and explicitly legacy.
Actual custody mode remains rejected even after legacy outbox grants are
restored. Later owner migration versions require an approved compatibility
follow-up; this scaffold does not claim readiness for the complete current
feature-migration catalog.

Document holder/company/branch/party, exact immutable byte version, purpose,
download MFA and business-owner authorization remain feature-specific.
The tenant-required event and command schema in the test is synthetic scoping
evidence only. It grants no document access and introduces no document policy,
upload/storage/download API, byte store, scanner, domain table or executable root.
Only UUID references enter synthetic payloads; no real personal documents,
credentials or broker connections are used.

## Verification

Git gate passed before application edits. Pinned Go 1.27.1, offline module cache
`/private/tmp/justixauto-t003-modcache`, build cache
`/private/tmp/justixauto-integration-gocache`, `GOPROXY=off`; scoped contracts
used project Node 24.21.0 via command-local PATH.

```sh
bash tools/check-git.sh
bash tools/go.sh test -race -count=1 ./services/documents/port ./services/documents/adapter/postgres
JUSTIXAUTO_TEST_DOCUMENTS_MECHANICS=1 bash tools/go.sh test -race -count=1 -v ./services/documents/port ./services/documents/adapter/postgres
JUSTIXAUTO_TEST_DOCUMENTS_MECHANICS=1 bash tools/go.sh test -race -count=1 ./services/... ./pkg/... ./tests/...
bash tools/go.sh vet ./services/... ./pkg/... ./tests/...
git diff --check
```

All passed. Documents opt-out race: 2.132s; focused live race: 16.097s;
full scoped run Documents: 17.282s, contracts: 119.443s. Vet exited zero.
Only the Documents live opt-in was enabled; other services/shared external
fixture suites remained disabled. No tools/owner-migrate or browser changes
are in this task and neither receives a completeness claim.

Live groups cover missing/dirty/newer/extra ledger state, wrong owner/database,
excess/missing direct/reachable/PUBLIC privileges, privileged session SET ROLE
masquerade rejected before binding/callback, six foreign-database connection
denials, factory/callback rollback, six concurrent identical commands converging
to one event/receipt/operation, changed-payload conflict, aggregate replay,
uncommitted-history invisibility, panic cleanup, cancelled entry, exact receipt
scope and lost replies wrapping real commit AND rollback. Recovery checks the
authoritative receipt; the runner never infers rollback from a missing reply.
Messaging tests install original shared additive SQL, test marker tampering and
perform actual fixture custody activation before asserting refusal.

Restricted session_replication_role role settings, parameter grants and
server-default mutations were not executed or reconstructed. Shared persistence
live suites were opt-out, including their trigger-mode probes; this is not full
live profile coverage. Existing automatic-review restrictions remain intact.

server version 180006. Each fixture uses UUID name plus an independent UUID

tmpfs and exactly one read-only original bootstrap bind, no persistent volumes.
All seven bootstrap owners remain identity/inventory/commerce/retail/financing/
insurance/documents; runtime foreign-denial checks are the six excluding Documents.

deleting only that immutable ID, then verifies absence by ID and name.
